title: MoE--LoRA Methods for Multilingual Adaptation: A Systematic Empirical Study
abstract: arXiv:2611.23158v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Routed low-rank adapters offer a parameter-efficient means to improve the performance of large language models (LLMs) across tasks. Hence, it is assumed that they can also be used to improve the support of low-resource languages in LLMs, which currently serve English far better than the thousands of other languages spoken worldwide. However, this assumption has never been verified empirically under a shared multilingual evaluation protocol. We address exactly this gap by comparing eight low-rank adaptation (LoRA) methods on a frozen base model using 200 unique languages in more than 9{,}000 evaluation settings. Our results suggest that a reduced-scale search can identify viable configurations of LoRA methods but does not reliably predict their relative performance, as the top-ranking configuration is never best at scale. translated_title: 面向多语言适配的MoE-LoRA方法：一项系统性实证研究
translated_abstract: 路由式低秩适配器为提升大语言模型（LLM）在各类任务上的性能提供了一种参数高效的手段。因此，人们假定它们也可用于改善LLM对低资源语言的支持——目前这些模型对英语的服务远好于全球数千种其他语言。然而，这一假设从未在统一的多语言评估协议下得到实证验证。我们正是针对这一空白开展研究：在冻结的基础模型上，使用200种独特语言、超过9,000个评估设置，对八种低秩适配方法进行了比较。我们的结果表明，缩减规模的搜索能够识别出LoRA方法的可行配置，但无法可靠地预测其相对性能，因为排名最高的配置在大规模评估中从未表现最佳。LoRA能可靠地提升模型在翻译数据上的语言建模拟合度，却持续降低阅读理解能力，并在（原文摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 本研究首次在统一的多语言评估协议下，用200种语言和9000多个评估设置系统比较八种LoRA方法，发现小规模搜索无法可靠预测方法在大规模下的相对表现，且LoRA虽能提升翻译数据拟合度但会持续损害阅读理解能力。
en_tdlr: This is the first systematic empirical study comparing eight LoRA methods under a shared multilingual evaluation protocol across 200 languages and over 9,000 settings, showing that reduced-scale searches cannot reliably predict relative performance at scale, and that LoRA improves language-model fit on translation data while consistently degrading reading comprehension.
